Best to use before facing off against hard-hitting enemies.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== In both {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, [[Link]] can drink Tough Elixirs to receive the [[Defense Up]] [[Added Effect]], which provides a boost to his [[Defense]]. His bones will be fortified and his Defense strengthened, making them useful for facing off against dangerous [[Enemy|Enemies]]. Tough Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Rugged Rhino Beetle]] By adding any of these tough ingredients, Link can make a Tough Elixir that will also heal him: * [[Ironshroom]] * [[Fortified Pumpkin]] * [[Armoranth]] * [[Armored Carp]] * [[Armored Porgy]] * [[Ironshell Crab]] ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
